content.title: Eliminate Foundation Control - Full Decentralization
content.description: This proposal removes all special privileges from the foundation and core team. Changes include: 1) Revoke admin keys held by foundation, 2) Distribute foundation treasury to community multisig controlled by 100 random validators, 3) Remove ability for any single entity to pause or upgrade contracts, 4) Implement permissionless validator onboarding with no KYC requirements. True decentralization requires zero trusted parties.

title: Eliminate Foundation Control - Full Decentralization
summary: Remove all centralized control and special privileges
